description: The correlation rules of ADR-041 D3: how a failure travels along the relations. A rule names a relation type, optionally the class of its from and to ends (subclasses too), the source condition that triggers it (type and status) and the status of the impact it produces on the relation's dependant (relations.json), optionally only for a dependant whose attributes match `dependant` ({attribute: value}; true matches any value set), which then beats a rule without one. The controller refuses a rule it cannot place; health-manager rules list|check shows and validates them. Shipped: an operational critical crosses runs-on, depends-on, member-of and connects as critical impact, runs-on as a warning to a guest with haNode set (HA moves it), and built-on from a disk to its pool; a warning crosses nothing.

rules.description: An HA-protected guest whose node fails is moving or has moved: degraded, not down.
A failed disk takes its pool down; in a mirror or raidz vdev (a redundancy group) it degrades it until every member has failed.
